issues.where: devayānāḥ / translation 'going the gods' way, we have gone'
issues.problem: The draft labels devayānāḥ as m. nom. pl. and attaches it to the unexpressed 'we' of aganma. But it sits directly after aghnyāḥ (f. voc. pl.), which has the same ending, and is at least as likely to be its adjective ('O aghnyās, travelling the gods' way'). Attaching it to 'we' is unsupported and aganma already carries the subject. The note and the low-certainty reading should say so.
issues.fix: Hindi: हे अघ्न्या, देवों के मार्ग पर चलने वाली, मुक्त हो जाओ; हमने इस अन्धकार के पार पहुँचकर ज्योति पा ली। English: Be released, O aghnyā, going the gods' way; we have gone to the far shore of this darkness; we have reached the light. Confidence should be low.

summary: Units 40-78: 9 errors, 17 minor issues. Errors: 44 satyāḥ gender; 45 Hindi adds 'for him'; 47 case of saptim/comparison (English and Hindi); 55 Hindi treats sūdadohasaḥ as object; 73 devayānāḥ attached to 'we'; 74 Hindi adds 'rays'; 78 mātaraḥ wrongly quoted (English and Hindi). Minors: Hindi/English mismatches, w-forms, gram labels, notes. 19 units are ok, 20 need fixes. No regrouping: unit 65 keeps the edition's grouping, though its third pada (namo bhūtyai ...) may be a separate formula, as the drafter noted.
